claim: The newly found Abhayagiri bronzes are provisionally comparable in style to seventh- and eighth-century artefacts and have been estimated at roughly 1,200-1,300 years old.
bounded_by: Stylistic comparison pending further analysis; no laboratory or peer-reviewed archaeological publication was available at intake time.
notes: Review after 2026-09-19 or when CCF/Department of Archaeology publishes analysis.
